title: 你到底做什么的？
title_en: So What Do You Actually Do?

series.next: 二姨 has already sent your photo to someone's mother.

setting: Grandma's house, the morning after the big lunch. The family group (23 members, four time zones) is awake, and 大姑 has news.

giveup.zh: 这孩子，问半天也不说话。
giveup.en: Honestly, this kid. Ask and ask, and not a word.

giveup.zh: 那我就跟街坊们说你是修手机的了！
giveup.en: Fine. I'm telling the whole street you fix phones!
By lunch, word is out: you fix phones. There's a queue of broken phones at Grandma's door.
giveup.zh: 奶奶家门口排起了长队。

dagu.name: 大姑
dagu.en: your dad's eldest sister: runs the phone shop in town, wants the facts

nainai.name: 奶奶
nainai.en: your dad's mum: can't read the screen, so she sends voice notes

biaoge.name: 表哥
biaoge.en: your cousin, 大姑's son: drives a van

eryi.name: 二姨
eryi.en: your mum's second sister: the family matchmaker

sanshu.name: 三叔
sanshu.en: your dad's younger brother: keeps fish

steps.narr: Breakfast at Grandma's, chopsticks in hand. The family group is buzzing.
steps.zh: 第二天早上，家族群炸了。
问清楚了！小宝是修手机的！
steps.en: Mystery solved: 小宝 fixes phones!
Back home to steal my customers!
大伯's phone: the screen cracked like a spider's web.

steps.zh: 一碗米里埋着一部手机
steps.en: 三叔's: a phone buried in a bowl of rice.

say.en: 大姑 has told the whole family you fix phones. Type it: not fixing phones, designing software!
answers: 不是修手机，是设计软件！
不是修手机，是做软件设计的！
我不修手机，我设计软件！
不是修手机啦，是做手机软件的！
say.tip: 不是……，是…… = not …, but … : how you set someone straight. 软件 ruǎnjiàn = software, apps.

ok.en: Software? And what's software when it's at home?

ok.zh: 说了半天，你到底做什么工作？
ok.en: All this talk. So what's your actual job?

fail.en: So do you fix phones or not?

1.tip: 软件 ruǎnjiàn = software, apps (软 soft + 件 item). 我是做……的 = I work in … .

3.en: She says you're after her customers. Tell her, with a smile, you're not: you make software.
answers: 不跟您抢生意，我做软件的！
放心，不抢您生意，我是做软件的。
我不跟大姑抢生意，我设计软件！
大姑放心，我是做软件的，不抢您生意！
3.gloss: I'm not after your customers. I make software!
3.tip: 抢生意 qiǎng shēngyi = to steal someone's customers. 我做软件的 = I make software (做……的 again).

say.en: Hold to talk (chopsticks in one hand): tell 大姑 you work in design.
say.tip: 我是做……的 = I work in … : how people name a line of work (做设计的, 做外贸的). 设计 shèjì = design.

1.tip: 设计师 shèjìshī = designer (设计 design + 师 a professional, as in 老师).

3.en: Hold to talk: tell 大姑 you work in design, and that it's going well, so she needn't worry.
answers: 做设计的，挺好的，您放心！
我是做设计的，挺好的，别担心。
做设计的，工作挺好，您放心吧。
我是搞设计的，挺稳定的，您放心。
3.gloss: I'm in design. It's going well, don't worry!
3.tip: 您放心 nín fàngxīn = don't worry (lit. put your heart down): the answer to what a relative is really asking, is the kid OK?

say.en: Explain what you design: the stuff everyone uses on their phones.
answers: 就是手机里用的那些东西。
就是大家手机上用的那些。
就是手机上用的那些软件。
say.gloss: You know, the things you use on your phone.
say.tip: 就是…… = it's just …, you know: how an explanation starts. 手机上用的那些 = the ones you use on your phone.

fail.en: Say it so your auntie can follow!

1.en: Explain: it's the stuff on your phone!
1.tip: 手机上 shǒujī shang = on the phone. 那些 nàxiē = those, the ones.

3.en: Explain with a wink: it's the stuff she scrolls on her phone all day.
answers: 就是您手机上天天刷的那些！
就是您每天在手机上用的那些！
您手机上天天刷的那些，都是软件！
就是您整天在手机上刷的那些！
3.gloss: You know, the stuff you scroll on your phone all day!
3.tip: 刷 shuā = to scroll (lit. to brush): 刷手机, scrolling your phone. 天天 = every day, all the time.

steps.zh: 掉鱼塘里了，在米里埋三天了。
steps.en: Mine fell in the fish pond. It's been in the rice three days.
A tyre track straight across the screen. 表哥 ran it over with his own van.

steps.zh: 宝贝，奶奶的手机也黑了，你快给奶奶看看。
steps.en: Sweetheart, Grandma's phone has gone black too. Come and have a look for me.
The whole family's counting on you!

say.en: Hold to talk: tell 奶奶 and everyone, honestly, that you really can't fix phones.

not.note: That says you CAN fix them. Can't is 不会修.

say.tip: 不会 = can't, never learned how (会 is a skill you have). 真的 = really, honestly.

mistakes.note: 不能 means not allowed, or not possible. Never learned how is 不会: 我不会修.

then.en: It's on, it's on! My clever darling!
Off and on again, and that fixed it?

then.zh: 以后你就是家里的技术员了！
then.en: From now on, you're the family's tech person!
So what about my phone in the rice?
You held Grandma's power button for ten seconds. The group crowns you 家里的技术员, and by lunch three more phones are waiting, one of them full of rice.

ok.zh: 行吧。那你给大姑的店设计个牌子！
ok.en: Fine. Then design a sign for my shop!
The old one's faded to nothing.

fail.en: Say something! The whole family's waiting!

1.en: Hold to talk: tell them you can't!
1.tip: 我不会 = I can't (I never learned how).

3.en: Hold to talk: say you can't fix them, and hand the job back to the expert, 大姑.
answers: 我不会修，大姑您才是专家！
修不了修不了，还得靠大姑！
我真不会修，大姑才是专家！
我不会修，您店里才能修！
3.gloss: I can't fix them. You're the expert, Auntie!
3.tip: ……才是专家 = … is the real expert: hand the job back to the pro, and flatter her while you're at it. 专家 zhuānjiā = expert.

answers: 那我试试，修坏了别怪我！
我试试吧，坏了可别怪我！
alts.gloss: I'll try. Don't blame me if I break it!

say.en: A job you CAN do. Tell 大姑: no problem, leave it to you!
say.gloss: No problem, leave it to me!
say.tip: 包在我身上 bāo zài wǒ shēnshang = leave it to me ('it's all on me'): the cheerful, confident yes. 交给我 = hand it over to me.

ok.en: Grandma's photo: your sketch for the new sign, on a paper napkin.
Love it! I'm having it made right now!

1.tip: 没问题 méi wèntí = no problem: the easy yes.

3.en: Tell her to leave it to you, and promise it'll look great.
answers: 没问题，包在我身上，保证好看！
放心交给我，保证比原来的好看！
3.gloss: Leave it to me. It'll look great, I promise!
3.tip: 保证 bǎozhèng = I promise, guaranteed: 保证好看 = it'll look great, promise.

steps.en: Lunchtime: the new sign, already up over 大姑's shop.

steps.zh: 我们家孩子设计的！都来看！
steps.en: Designed by our kid! Come and see!
My darling designed it, so of course it's beautiful!

steps.zh: 这孩子真能干！有对象没有？
steps.en: What a capable kid! Seeing anyone yet?
By lunch the sign is up, and 大姑 tells every customer who designed it. In the group, 二姨 has gone very quiet.
steps.zh: 大姑逢人就说：我们家孩子设计的！
